argument: Round-1 mechanics audit. The chapter's numeric spine mostly recomputes and should not be re-investigated: the budget table prints the three flat rows; the four per-class rank ladders reproduce ch05 entry for entry; flat card prices 2/4/8 and the L3/L7 gates agree with ch05 and ch10; all nine class starting sets match ch05; the weapon combinations at 08:210 match ch15 exactly; and every line of the total-cost callout and the Fire-mage build balances (6, 3, 16, 6, and 7 DP, with Adept 3/6/9 and Master 6/12/18 falling straight out of the subtraction). Five sites break. (1) 08:248 prints the Novice attribute-scaled base as 1/2/3, but the same sentence derives every base by taking three off the budget row, and 2/4/6 less three is -1/1/3; so the printed Standard value 2 has no source and the Weak value is negative before the minimum-one clause. The printed 1/2/3 is exactly the Basic-attack floor in ch09 (melee, archery, thrown; unarmed sits at 1/1/2). If only one half can survive I keep the floor triplet, because ch21 repeats it, and I would scope the subtraction to Adept and Master or add an explicit floor clause. (2) The same line credits melee weapons with damage values of their own, but ch15 carries no damage column and states the card supplies the row and the weapon never alters it, and 08:250 in this same chapter agrees with ch15. Expected: melee attack cards add Brawn to the card's budget row. (3) 08:133 folds skill into the discipline-gated ladder and equates tier with a rank count, while 08:15 and 08:113 exempt skills and ch07 says no skill is gated; expected spells and abilities only. (4) 08:107 makes an item's granted rank depend on wielding and end when it is set down, but ch17 keys the grant to attunement; the blade's name is correct, the condition is not. (5) 08:263 renders the Master fire effect as raw damage each round across a fixed three-round span; ch11:134 gives the named condition Burning 2, which has no fixed duration. No dice, no retired vocabulary (chains, classifications, multipliers, General, Standard+), and nothing adds a discipline to a roll.

evidence.claim: The attribute-scaled sentence states one subtraction rule covering all tiers and prints the Novice base beside it.
Subtracting three from the chapter's own Novice inputs gives a negative value, then one, then three, so the printed Standard of two has no source.
The chapter's own flat Novice row is the input that the subtraction consumes, and the table prints no dice.
The Basic attack cards fix the no-prereq floor at 1/2/3, matching the chapter's printed Novice triplet.
The weapon table has no damage column; the ability card supplies the row and the weapon leaves it unchanged.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The weapon never changes these numbers.

evidence.claim: Skills carry tiers and prices but no character ever needs a discipline to buy or use one.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: None of them have Discipline prerequisites

evidence.claim: Item-granted ranks last while the hero stays attuned; ending attunement, not sheathing, is what removes them.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: any Disciplines it granted are lost

evidence.claim: The Master effect of the same spell is stated as the locked named condition rather than a round count.
Burning's duration is action-based, so a fixed three-round span is not part of the mechanic.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Takes X fire damage per round

evidence.claim: The four rank-cost structures the chapter tabulates are the ones the classes chapter actually uses.
Every worked total in the callout and the build recomputes against ch05, including the already-holds-rank-one case.
